activity_summary: On the empty stage, with frost still on the yard rail, Nick read the vial once to himself and then spoke the two lines. You said it was very good. He called Nurse, and the voice cracked into a man's note. Nobody laughed. Arthur, on a hamper, had nothing to add and did not offer the part. Nick finished a third lower, without the call. He asked if she would be long. You said two acts, and that she sleeps through some of it. Phillips said to send him mornings, that it can be nursed and cannot be mended. No hour was named. You told Garnish to leave the sheet. You did not say, in the room, that you would refuse to cut her.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Called the lines very good, answered the question about the lady, and stopped the book from deciding.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Spoke the lines exactly, cracked on the call, and finished lower.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Offered mornings from the door, and refused a cure he had not promised.

entities.name: Arthur Meeks
entities.context: Stayed on the hamper, studied his nails, and did not take the part.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Asked after the book, was told to leave the sheet, and cut nothing.

entities.name: the vial speech
entities.context: Mentioned in Nurse, and then not

facets.activity: Heard Nick's voice crack on the call

quotes.speaker: nick_sorrell
quotes.text: I haue a faint cold feare thrills through my veines,

quotes.speaker: nick_sorrell
quotes.text: Will she be long, Master Shakespeare?

quotes.speaker: augustine_phillips
quotes.text: Send him to me mornings. It can be nursed. It can't be mended.
